$comment: The owner's waivers of release-check cases. Read by __tests__/helpers/releaseWaivers.ts; only its WAIVABLE_CASES consult this file, and an entry passes its case only when it is complete. Each entry: the case id, the files it covers, the owner's verbatim words, the date of the decision, the register row (D-<n>) that tracks the debt, and the release (package.json's version) it was decided for: an entry of another release waives nothing.
